title: $20 Million In Fines And Still Vizio Smart TVs Opt Out Of Spying Option Does Nothing - PC Perspective
excerpt: $20 Million In Fines And Still Vizio Smart TVs Opt Out Of Spying Option Does Nothing The big winner was Vizio, where there was no change at all in traffic
content_html:
There’s A Quote From Leftist Gamer Memes (Not Final Fantasy Tactics) Which Seems Applicable

We’ve already heard the reports about the behaviour of LG TVs as well as the absolute denials from them about what researchers found, now new research has been published about the behaviour of some of their competitors.  As you should expect, that news is not good.  Researchers at Northeastern University conducted 5,943 experiments across twelve commercial smart TVs to see just what opting out of automatic content recognition monitoring options did.

Instead of trying to determine what ACR data was being sent to IP addresses known to be associated with advertisers and personal data trackers they instead monitored the effect on the traffic generated by a TV when it was opted out of optional data harvesting.  Devices using webOS, Fire OS, Sony Google TV, and VIDAA OS did indeed stop sending traffic when requested to using the options in the menu, only 60% of the Samsung Tizen smart TVs showed decreased or no traffic.

The big winner was Vizio, where there was no change at all in traffic when the option to disable any and all tracking was enabled.  They simply carried on as if you had agreed to share all your data.  Again, the researchers didn’t attempt to read the traffic, they only monitored it’s volume and destinations.  Vizio was fined $2.2 million by the FTC in 2017 for not informing customers of their TV’s spying habits which resulted in a $17 million lawsuit which Vizio lost.  It would seem that the income they rake in from spying outweighs the cost of being caught.

Also, before you congratulate yourself on using a TV running VIDAA, such as Hisense and Toshiba, you should know that traffic from the ACR data they collect is sent completely and totally unencrpyted and contains things which should not be.
